runs.content: US markets (NYSE/NASDAQ) were closed for Labor Day, so no new trade was entered. All 35 open positions were repriced off Friday Sept 4's close: no stop-losses, T1/T2 triggers, or signal exits fired, and no discretionary action was warranted — the healthiest cross-section of the book in recent runs, with zero positions at or below the −10% watch threshold. AVGO (Burry Sector Warning) remains the weakest continuing position at −7.21%, improved from −7.41%. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,577 (+4.60% on $56,000). Strategy selection and the weekly performance review resume Tuesday Sept 8.

RELX PLC picked up at the previous close ($36.65) — entered on a hot August jobs report (+162K vs. +53K est.) that pushed rate-hike odds up and stocks down broadly, favouring defensive/value names; RELX's wide-moat Morningstar discount (FV $57, reconfirmed Aug 6, ~36% discount at entry) carries no negative earnings catalyst, chosen over Clorox (confirmed value trap, still falling), Ecolab (shallow discount) and Ameriprise (no longer discounted). CMCL hit T2 @ $26.32 (+51.88%), banking ~$506 on the second tranche. YUMC was exited discretionarily (−8.45%, −$84) to keep the book at 35 open positions after RELX's entry — no mechanical stop-losses or signal exits on the other 33 continuing positions; AVGO (Burry Sector Warning) is now the weakest continuing position at −7.41%. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,839 (+5.07% on $56,000).
